description: List employers from the State of ATS 2026 dataset, optionally filtered by ATS vendor (case-insensitive substring, e.g. 'workday', 'greenhouse', 'oracle') and/or industry (substring, e.g. 'health', 'consulting'). Returns at most 100 rows per call — narrow the filters or fetch the full dataset from https://withresumeai.com/api/v1/ats.

verified_only.description: Only rows confirmed against the live careers portal (default false)
